text:
Predicates:
BakedSweets(x) ::: x is a baked sweet.
Spicy(x) ::: x is spicy.
Cupcake(x) ::: x is a cupcake.
MalaHotpot(x) ::: x is a mala hotpot.
ProductOfBakedByMelissa(x) ::: x is a product from Baked by Melissa.
DriedThaiChilies(x) ::: x is dried Thai chilies.
Premises:
∀x (BakedSweets(x) → ¬Spicy(x)) ::: No baked sweets are spicy.
∀x (Cupcake(x) → BakedSweets(x)) ::: All cupcakes are baked sweets.
∀x (MalaHotpot(x) → Spicy(x)) ::: All mala hotpots are spicy.
∀x (ProductOfBakedByMelissa(x) → Cupcake(x)) ::: All products from Baked by Melissa are cupcakes.
DriedThaiChilies(x) ∨ MalaHotpot(x) ∨ ¬BakedSweets(x) ::: Dried Thai chilies are spicy or mala hotpots or not baked sweets.
Conclusion:
¬ProductOfBakedByMelissa(driedThaiChilies) ::: Dried Thai chilies are not products of Baked by Melissa.
